name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Zelensky’s Dizzying U-Turn Is the Latest Zigzag in a Presidency Full of Them
changes.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine has pivoted from unpopular moves before, but a recent decision about military leadership and strategy could weaken his position.

changes.title: A New Target for Ukraine’s Long-Range Attacks: Russia’s Version of Amazon
changes.summary: Kyiv is escalating its air war by striking commercial warehouses, trying to bring the conflict closer to home for ordinary Russians.

changes.title: Ukraine targets Russian online retailer Wildberries
changes.summary: Ukrainian long-range drones targeted large warehouses belonging to Wildberries, Russia’s equivalent of Amazon, which sells military equipment like body armor and drone parts, but mainly serves as a place for regular Russians to sell their goods. changes.title: Firing of Ukraine’s Top General Signals the End of an Era
changes.summary: Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi, who commanded crucial battles, oversaw an expansion of drone warfare against Russia, but many Ukrainians want even more.

changes.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy fires top military commander amid ongoing protests
changes.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy fires the country's army chief, just days after he dismissed the defense minister. Those two key figures had been feuding with each other.

changes.title: Mykhailo Drapatyi: What to Know About Ukraine’s New Top General
changes.summary: Maj. Gen. Mykhailo Drapatyi, a decorated commander, is popular both inside and outside of his country.

changes.title: News Wrap: Gulf Coast prepares for Tropical Storm Bertha

changes.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy fires his commander in chief after protests and major rift
changes.summary: The firing caps a major crisis for Volodymyr Zelenskyy after Ukrainians took to the streets to call for Oleksandr Syrskyi’s resignation.

changes.title: Tech innovator and old guard general are focus of Ukraine's political crisis
changes.summary: When their personalities and policies clashed, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy decided to fire popular young Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov and keep Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi.

changes.title: Zelensky Dismisses Ukraine’s Top General After Protests
changes.summary: The move followed the firing of a popular defense minister, who had clashed with the general over how to fight the war.
